targets.title: Zoo Index
targets.purpose: Entry page for the live component catalog.

targets.title: Token Foundations
targets.purpose: Production token swatches for colors, radii, shadows, and hit targets.

targets.title: Theme Matrix
targets.purpose: All cuisine themes rendered side by side from real components.

targets.title: Button
targets.purpose: Primary action control with four variants and three token-sized touch targets.

targets.title: Badge
targets.purpose: Small status label; rounded-full pill. Exports BadgeVariant type.

targets.title: Card
targets.purpose: Elevated content container. Composition: CardHeader + CardTitle + CardContent + CardFooter.

targets.title: Dialog
targets.purpose: Modal dialog with overlay, title, optional footer. z-50 budget.

targets.title: Input
targets.purpose: Text input with label, error, helperText slots. Focus ring tied to --color-primary.

targets.title: Toggle
targets.purpose: Boolean switch. 200ms slide animation. ON uses --color-primary.

targets.title: Select
targets.purpose: Dropdown with options array. Keyboard navigable. z-20 menu.

targets.title: ImageUpload
targets.purpose: Drag-drop image upload with progress indicator, preview, and remove. Calls API client directly (internal i18n + api lib import).

targets.title: Toast
targets.purpose: Toast notification renderer. Mounted via ToastProvider + useToast(). Exports ToastContainer + ToastData type.

targets.title: TourOverlay
targets.purpose: Onboarding step highlighter with spotlight hole + next/prev controls. Uses i18n for step text.

targets.title: LanguagePicker
targets.purpose: Locale switcher dropdown — cycles through en/zh/ja/ko/fr. Uses useT() hook to display localized names.

targets.title: DietaryIcon
targets.purpose: The ONE sanctioned way to render dietary / allergen / spice / promo markers in Nexus UI. Emoji / unicode alternatives are banned (S-DIETARY-SPRITE).

targets.title: DataTable
targets.purpose: Sortable, filterable table with generic row typing. Header click toggles sort.

targets.title: FormField
targets.purpose: Label + input + error wrapper. Composes Input under a label with gap-1.5.

targets.title: StatusBadge
targets.purpose: Order-status / generic-status badge that maps status enum to Badge variant + capitalized label.

targets.title: EmptyState
targets.purpose: No-data placeholder. Icon → title → context → single CTA button.

targets.title: ConfirmButton
targets.purpose: Two-click destructive action with 3s auto-reset. S-CONFIRM-DESTRUCTIVE requires this for delete/cancel/remove actions.

targets.title: ErrorBoundary
targets.purpose: React error boundary fallback — catches thrown errors in a subtree and shows a recoverable message. Only class component in codebase (React API requires class).

targets.title: PullToRefreshIndicator
targets.purpose: Mobile pull-to-refresh visual indicator. Shows loading spinner once pull distance exceeds threshold.

targets.title: AddToCartToast
targets.purpose: Customer-flow confirmation pill — slides up briefly after an item is added to cart. Uses slide-up-fade keyframe.

targets.title: OrderTracker
targets.purpose: Themed order status timeline. Horizontal step tracker with connector lines and pulsing active bubble. Supports dine-in (Received→Preparing→Ready→Served) and delivery (Received→Preparing→On the way→Delivered) modes. data-theme wrapper drives full theme cascade.

targets.title: Receipt
targets.purpose: Themed visual receipt block for the customer confirmation screen (NOT a print template). Monospace font, dashed dividers, itemised line items, subtotal/tax/tip rows, bold total, and a thank-you footer. data-theme wrapper drives full theme cascade.

targets.title: PromoCard
targets.purpose: Themed promotion banner with primary-colour background, decorative accent circle, large discount headline, and mono-font promo-code chip. All props are optional — render any subset. data-theme wrapper drives full theme cascade.

targets.title: CheckoutSummary
targets.purpose: Themed cart/order summary block: itemised line items, divider, per-line cost breakdown (subtotal / delivery / tax), bold total, and a full-width place-order CTA that mirrors the total in its label. Display-only — pass onPlaceOrder for the mutation. data-theme wrapper drives full theme cascade.
